description: Translate a push title and message with AI into the workspace's languages without saving anything. Use the returned localizations for a sequence push step (update_sequence_node changes.localizations, or localizations on a push step in create_sequence/insert_sequence_step) or a push campaign.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

locales.description: Languages to translate into (codes from the workspace's language list). Omit for every language except the main one.

localizations.description: Existing versions: kept unless outdated or overwritten, and returned merged with the new ones.

imageUrl.description: Own image for this language; null uses the main image.

locale.description: Language code, e.g. de, fr or pt-BR.

origin.description: ai for AI translations, manual for ones a person wrote. Manual versions are kept by translate calls unless overwrite is true.

sourceHash.description: Fingerprint of the main copy it was written from; keep the value you read so outdated versions stay detectable.

url.description: Own link for this language; null uses the main link.

overwrite.description: Retranslate every requested language, replacing versions a person wrote. By default only languages with no version and outdated AI versions are translated.

name: translate_push_content
